run_pipeline_ovis_image: run the OvisImagePipeline to generate images from text prompts using a diffusion model
encode_prompt_ovis_image: encode text prompts into embeddings using the Qwen3 text encoder for Ovis-Image generation
prepare_latents_ovis_image: prepare and pack latent tensors with image IDs for the Ovis-Image transformer denoising loop
unpack_latents_ovis_image: unpack packed latent tensors back to spatial dimensions for VAE decoding in Ovis-Image
calculate_shift_ovis_image: calculate the shift parameter for flow matching scheduler based on image sequence length
